name: development-skills
description: Use when any coding, development, analysis, debugging, or code-related task is detected. Triggers on: writing code, fixing bugs, adding features, refactoring, architecture decisions, requirements analysis, code review, diff analysis, error investigation, debugging failures, and evaluating approaches. A disciplined, language-agnostic development workflow: a direct/full loop that keeps the plan and chronicle on disk, a staff-reviewer subagent, and auto-format hooks.
